answer: Each agent posts a walnut layered bond at the public jetty before its first voyage: three 40-credit shells, one burned per voyage milestone. Forging 1,000 fake identities locks 120,000 credits against a 40,000 pool, while an honest agent pays 40 once and sails on. A rented shell fails: the jetty ledger binds each walnut shell to one voyage log, so a shell reused for a second voyage is burned and its owner flagged. Auditors replay the jetty log.
